title: DOSE-10060 receipt
description: One signed receipt per fetch: which card was read, and when. A receipt is written alongside the answer, after it has gone; the caller does not wait for it and reads it by its id. It holds a hash of what was asked, never the text. Receipts form one hash chain per issuing region, each under its own key. Version 1.3, 2026-11-18. Amended 18 November 2026: receipt v 4. The chain name is out of the receipt id and is the receipt's own chain field; the id given with the answer is the receipt's own id whichever region signs. Reading a card's page is a fetch and leaves a receipt. A voluntary test payment gets its own receipt (kind test_payment). Earlier receipts keep their ids: v 3 of 18 November 2026 (rco-dosidal:<chain>:<uuid>; where the region named could not write, another wrote under its own chain name and the same uuid) and v 2 of 16 to 18 November 2026. The closing entry of a closed chain, and the receipts of the closed chains fr, wus2 and sea, are answered by id, hash, signature and place only and are outside this profile.

id.description: The receipt's own id, given with the answer. It names no chain.

chain.description: The chain the receipt is on: the chain of the region that signed it.

prev_hash.description: The hash of the receipt before it on the same chain.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS form of the receipt without hash, kid and sig.

kid.description: The chain's key, in the keyring; a retired key stays published.

sig.description: ES256 (raw r||s, base64url) over the JCS form of the receipt without sig.

query_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS form of {"tool": "fetch", "code": what was asked, ends trimmed, in capitals}. What was asked is the code, or the card's address, or, for a card read at its own address, the path of that address.

cards.description: The cards read, each as <record id>@<version>; the first 50 when a code names more.

card_count.description: How many cards the answer held; 0 for the empty answer.

market.description: The market of the cards read; - when none or more than one.

rule_version.description: The standard version and the access rule applied, joined by +, e.g. 1.3+open-read:fetch.

answer_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS form of the answer exactly as served: the card with its stamp, or the list of cards, or the empty list.

rules: The receipt key and the record key are different keys. Neither signs the other's object.
Checking a receipt needs no key and no sign-in, and writes nothing; every key in the keyring is accepted.
Each issuing region signs under its own key and writes its own chain; no region needs another. A copy that holds no key has its receipt signed by a region.
Each chain is checkpointed and mirrored. The chains fr, wus2 and sea are closed and are answered by id, hash, signature and place only; fr-2, wus2-2 and sea-2 continue.
